task: Wire the chapter-by-chapter auto-advancing bookContinuousPlayback engine into the Book tab's Continue Listening card, replacing the old single-file whole-book playback path.

frontend/src/pages/Book/stages/BookStage.summary: Destructures chapters from useBookDataContext() and threads it through as a new chapters prop to BookInfoCard.

frontend/src/pages/Book/components/BookI.summary: BookInfoCardProps gained chapters: Chapter[] (default [] at destructure for safety). Passes chapters, bookId=project.id, bookTitle=project.name through to ContinueListeningCard in addition to the existing audiobooks/coverImagePath props.

frontend/src/pages/Book/components/Conti.summary: Props gained bookId: string, bookTitle: string, chapters: Chapter[]. Builds `queue = buildChapterQueue(chapters)` via useMemo and calls useAutoSaveResumePosition(bookId, queue) unconditionally. Play button ('Continue Listening') is now gated on queue.length > 0 (not on audiobooks) and calls playBookContinuous(bookId, bookTitle, queue) instead of the old loadAndPlay({scope:'book',...}) whole-file playback. Empty state is now gated on queue.length === 0 (chapters, not assembled audiobooks) but still renders a working Download button off audiobooks[0] if one exists even when the queue is empty. Card label now shows 'Resume: Chapter N: <title>' computed from getAutoResumeBookmark(bookId) matched against the queue (falls back to index 0), replacing the old static 'Full audiobook' subtitle. handleDownload is unchanged, still keyed off audiobooks[0].
calls_removed: ContinueListeningCard.tsx -> playerBus.ts (loadAndPlay, for the book-scope whole-file Play action)

flow_impact: Completes the UI integration side of the chapter-by-chapter continuous playback engine added in 2026-07-12T18-30-00Z-book-continuous-playback-engine.json: Book tab's Continue Listening card now drives playback through playBookContinuous/useAutoSaveResumePosition instead of playing the single assembled audiobook file. ProjectCard.tsx (Library card) is a separate, still-in-progress parallel integration of the same engine and was not touched here.
